    month_days = [31, 29 if is_leap else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    total = day

        total += month_days[m]
    return total

    running = 1
    for value in lst:
        running = running * value
        result.append(running)
    return result
